cohort: The study included 119 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes between 24 and 26 weeks gestation at a tertiary education and research hospital.
finding: Diabetic school education was associated with lower maternal HbA1c levels, less weight gain during pregnancy, and reduced need for insulin therapy.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in mode of delivery between pregnant women who participated in the diabetes education program and those who did not.
